data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for smart card readers using CCID protocol with PC/SC-like APIs.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables reading and writing smart cards via the CCID protocol and PC/SC-like APIs. It supports Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.
use_when: You need to communicate with smart card readers in a Flutter application across multiple platforms.
You want to use PC/SC-like APIs or CCID protocol for smart card operations on desktop or mobile.
avoid_when: You do not require smart card or hardware token integration in your app.
strengths: Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Provides PC/SC-like APIs and implements the CCID protocol.
weaknesses: Requires external native dependencies on Linux (PCSCLite).
Requires specific platform entitlements and configurations like the smartcard entitlement on macOS/iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android Gradle 8.14+ and Java 17+. Linux requires PCSCLite runtime dependencies (pcscd, libpcsclite1). macOS/iOS require the com.apple.security.smartcard entitlement.
